name: Big Bang
description: The origin of the observable universe: expansion from an extremely hot, dense initial state.

name: Recombination (CMB released)
description: The universe becomes transparent; the cosmic microwave background is released about 380,000 years after the Big Bang.

name: First stars form
description: The first generation of stars ignites, ending the cosmic dark ages.

name: Milky Way forms
description: The oldest stars of our galaxy date to roughly 13.6 billion years ago.

name: Sun
description: Our star, from its formation to the present.

name: Earth
description: Our planet, from accretion to the present.

props.source: Patterson 1956, Age of meteorites and the earth

name: Moon-forming impact
description: A Mars-sized body (Theia) collides with the proto-Earth; the debris forms the Moon.

name: Late Heavy Bombardment
description: Hypothesized spike of asteroid impacts on the inner planets.

name: Milky Way / Andromeda merger
description: The Milky Way and Andromeda galaxies are projected to merge.

name: Sun becomes a red giant
description: Stellar evolution models project the Sun expands into a red giant, likely engulfing the inner planets.

name: Conventional star formation ends
description: Gas for new stars is projected to be exhausted; the stelliferous era closes.

name: Black-hole era
description: Under standard models, black holes become the dominant remaining structures.

name: Heat death of the universe
description: A possible far-future state of maximum entropy, under some cosmological models.
